title: Knowledge & Understanding Questions
page_title: Knowledge & Understanding Questions - CIE A Level Business

blocks.md:
- Knowledge and understanding involves recognising and effectively using key:

  - **business terms**
  - **business concepts**
  - **formulas**
  - **business theories**, **methods **and **models**
- Knowledge can also be demonstrated by **making relevant points**, such as stating a valid feature, benefit, drawback or implication

blocks.text: Marks for knowledge in exam papers

blocks.md: - Overall, **25% of the total marks available **are awarded for knowledge and understanding across all four exam papers

- **Define **requires you to give a precise meaning of a business term

  - Define questions are awarded 2 marks
- In this example, two marks are awarded for **clear understanding** and** valid examples **of secondary research

| Define the term ‘secondary research’.

[2] | |---| | ![Text explaining secondary market research using existing information from others with industry reports, websites, or newspapers, marked with green ticks.](assets/f97cc82d6a97-7080-define-example.bin) |

- **Identify **requires you to name, select or recognise an element, such as a factor, type, benefit or drawback

  - Identify questions are awarded 1 mark

| Identify one benefit for a business of a unique selling point (USP).
